limitations: Petroleum histories are current-vintage tables first observed September 14, 2026; historical release vintages and original publication timestamps are unknown.
All twelve series share one EIA weekly petroleum family and are not independent evidence votes.
Raw EIA publisher bodies were not included in the bridge; this run verified derived bytes, manifest entries, capture lineage, and original row hashes.
Gas-storage and electricity tests were blocked because preserved bodies/numeric tables were unavailable and neither source was due.
Product supplied is an imperfect demand proxy; the analysis has no weather, calendar, export-demand, outage, yield, or causal adjustment.
No eligible finalized original-energy report existed; the bridge is evidence, not an inherited conclusion.
